title: No Type Switch
statement: Implement `solve(kinds)`. `kinds` is a list of `email` and `sms`. A type switch would test each kind. Collapse that to one `send` call per item. Return `{"results": [...], "deleted_checks": ["email", "sms"]}` where results are `kind:ok` in order. `deleted_checks` is always those two names, the branches you removed.
constraints: The loop does not name the classes
hints: Map kind to an object with send.
The deleted checks are the two kind names, in that order.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An isinstance ladder lists every type the author knew about.

editorial: An isinstance ladder lists every type the author knew about. Replacing each arm with a method leaves the loop with one call. The deleted_checks list is the documentation of what the ladder used to say. Adding a channel no longer edits the loop.
